says: The light inside an item slot's quality rim (ctl.qualityRim in Ordaen/art.luna): a 40 px slot's inner glow (64 x 64 texels), white, stretched over the slot under its 2 px line and tinted with the quality's colour by ItemButton.
origin: Drawn by the design's ItemSlot (its quality border's blurred inset shadow): wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/quality-rim.mjs` writes a page from the component's own style, drawn white; the page shot at 1.6x on black and on white with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 400 --height 600 --scale 1.6` (`?bg=black`, `?bg=white`), then matted.
